info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Customer Reviews Submission API enables businesses to facilitate the submission of customer reviews regarding banking market data operations. By leveraging this API, users can gather valuable feedback and insights from clients about their experiences with specific market data switches. This is particularly beneficial for financial institutions looking to enhance their offerings and improve customer satisfaction. Typical consumers of this API include product managers, customer experience teams, and developers integrating review functionalities into their platforms.

post.summary: Create a review for a specific market data switch operation.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the market data switch operation identified by RES-100045. The review can provide feedback on the operation's performance, usability, and overall satisfaction.
